# braintrust_group_membership (Resource)

Manages one user's membership in a Braintrust permission group without managing the group's other members. Use for built-in groups or leave member_users unset on a managed group. Import with group_id/user_id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Permission group ID.
- `user_id` (String) Member user ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in group_id/user_id form.
